ValidationRule.description: Case Reason must be 'Promotion (NQC)' if Status field value is 'Sent to External Team'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', TEXT($User.UserType) <> 'AutomatedProcess', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Latam_Non_Quality', ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Sent to Agency Promo'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Reason, 'Promotion (NQC)')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Reason must be "Promotion (NQC)" when Status is "Sent to Agency Promo"
